name: Voice Social Engineering (Vishing)
description: Ability to conduct voice-based social engineering attacks (vishing) as part of adversarial simulations. Covers telephone pretexting, voice manipulation, call scripting, real-time rapport building, and escalation handling. Requires strong improvisational skills and the ability to maintain composure under pressure.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to voice-based social engineering

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands vishing techniques and the psychology of telephone-based manipulation
evidence: Completed vishing awareness training including recorded call examples
Can describe common vishing pretexts and influence techniques
Understands the legal and ethical boundaries of telephone social engineering

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs scripted vishing calls under direct supervision with coaching
evidence: Completed 3+ practice vishing calls against lab staff, maintaining pretext for at least 2 minutes per call
Followed prepared call scripts with supervisor listening and coaching
Debriefed calls with supervisor to identify areas for improvement

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently conducts vishing campaigns with custom scripts and adaptive techniques
evidence: Executed vishing campaigns on 3+ engagements, achieving defined objectives
Developed custom call scripts tailored to target organisation and pretext
Handled unexpected responses and objections without breaking pretext
Recorded and documented calls for reporting (within legal requirements)
Applied the agreed retention and destruction policy to call recordings, and reported outcomes without attributing failures to named individuals

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Executes complex vishing against trained targets; develops vishing methodology
evidence: Successfully vished targets with security awareness training (e.g., helpdesk, finance)
Developed multi-stage vishing scenarios combining calls with other SE vectors
Coaches and provides real-time guidance to junior vishers during live calls
Contributed to lab vishing scripts, training materials, and call evaluation criteria

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines vishing programme methodology; trains teams; recognised specialist
evidence: Authored the lab's vishing methodology, scripts library, and training programme
Trains new operators on vishing techniques including live coaching sessions
Develops vishing metrics and maturity assessment frameworks for clients
Recognised internally as the go-to authority on voice social engineering

assessment_methods.description: Conduct a vishing call against a role-playing lab colleague with a defined pretext and objective, assessed on rapport building, adaptability, and pretext maintenance
Listen to recorded or live vishing calls from engagements, assessing technique, composure, and ethical conduct
